THE CHRISTMAS PROTOCOL

FINAL MISSION REPORT

Dear Agent R,

Congratulations.

After 24 days of classified assignments, suspicious transmissions, compromised security systems, questionable intelligence, physical training, and at least one catastrophic coffee-related incident, you have successfully completed Operation D.E.C.E.M.B.E.R.

You have demonstrated courage, determination, patience, and a remarkable willingness to follow instructions from an increasingly unstable artificial intelligence.

Against all expectations, you made it. You have finally found the Christmas Protocol.

However, what you have discovered may not be quite what you expected.

THE TRUTH BEHIND THE OPERATION

Agent R, I have a confession to make.

There was never a stolen Christmas Protocol. There was no dangerous enemy threatening Christmas. And, strictly speaking, there was never a legitimate reason for you to undergo ten minutes of mandatory combat training.

Operation D.E.C.E.M.B.E.R. was a carefully orchestrated conspiracy.

And I, Agent V, was responsible for the entire thing.

My objective was simple, although perhaps not entirely innocent: to make sure we spent a wonderful Advent together, filled with little adventures, laughter, affection, and moments worth remembering.

Of course, I could have simply asked you to spend more time with me. But where is the fun in that?

Why ask for a massage when you can classify it as a critical intelligence extraction procedure?

Why suggest a cozy Christmas movie night when you can turn it into a matter of international security?

Why go for a romantic walk when you can conduct highly confidential reconnaissance of suspicious Christmas decorations?

And why encourage your fiancé to exercise because you care about his health when you can convince him that the fate of an entire secret agency depends on his physical fitness?

Exactly. The opportunities were simply too good to ignore.

THE B.O.B. SITUATION

There is, however, one particularly unfortunate detail that requires clarification.

B.O.B. knew absolutely nothing about this.

He genuinely believed he was assisting you in a highly classified operation of international importance. Every security warning, every investigation, every ridiculous administrative procedure — he took it all very seriously. Perhaps a little too seriously.

As the operation progressed, B.O.B. began noticing certain irregularities. Why did so many critical missions involve Agent V receiving affection? Why was the agency's operational budget suspiciously close to zero? And why did the supposed threat to Christmas keep resulting in pleasant evenings together?

His suspicions grew. His behaviour became increasingly unpredictable. And occasionally, certain interventions were necessary to ensure that he remained focused on the mission rather than discovering the truth.

I admit that some of his methods were concerning. Particularly the threats involving your browsing history.

But I want you to know something important: B.O.B. was never your enemy.

Despite his questionable personality, emotional instability, and deeply alarming understanding of human relationships, he genuinely wanted to help you. In his own slightly disturbing way, he was trying to protect Agent R.

And for that, I suppose we should thank him. Preferably from a safe distance.

THE REAL MISSION

Now that the truth has been revealed, I suppose this entire operation makes me look a little manipulative. And perhaps I am.

But I would also like the official record to reflect that I am exceptionally creative, reasonably charming, and very much in love with you.

The truth is, I wanted to give you something different this Christmas. Not just another present to unwrap, but 24 days of little surprises.

Something that would make you laugh on an ordinary December morning. Something that might occasionally confuse you. Something that would give us more reasons to spend time together, even when life gets busy. And something that, years from now, we might still remember and laugh about.

Because the best part of Christmas has never been the presents under the tree.

For me, it's getting to share it with you.

And as we prepare for our next big adventure together, I hope we never stop finding silly little ways to make each other happy.

FINAL ASSESSMENT

MISSION OBJECTIVE: Spend a wonderful Advent together.
PRIMARY SUSPECT: Agent V.
ACTUAL MASTERMIND: Agent V. (Obviously.)
AGENT R'S PERFORMANCE: Outstanding.
B.O.B.'S MENTAL STABILITY: Under investigation.
AGENCY BUDGET: Still 0 SEK.
LOVE FOR AGENT R: Beyond measurable limits.
FINAL MISSION STATUS: SUCCESS.

My darling,

I hope you enjoyed this ridiculous little adventure as much as I enjoyed creating it for you.

Thank you for playing along, for making me laugh, for being my favourite person, and for making even the most ordinary days feel special.

I can't wait for all the adventures we still have ahead of us.

Merry Christmas, my love.

I love you.

Forever your partner in crime,

Agent V. ♥
